meta.name: dev-sciomc
meta.description: Scientific method scaffolding — hypothesis → experiment → evidence → conclusion. Use when you need rigorous causal reasoning rather than vibes-based debugging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用科学方法框架进行严谨因果推理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在调试或研究中应用科学方法而非直觉判断。
copy.tagline_en: Apply scientific method for rigorous causal reasoning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need rigorous causal reasoning over vibes-based debugging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照科学方法框架进行工程调查：先明确一个可证伪的假设，然后设计实验（包括变量、对照组和样本量），收集原始数据，进行统计分析，最后给出暂定结论和局限性。
howto.when: 当你需要严谨的因果推理（而非凭感觉调试）时触发，例如性能优化、A/B 比较或高成本错误场景。

say.text: 比较两种排序算法的速度，设计一个严谨的实验。
say.note: Claude 会生成假设、实验步骤和对照方案。

say.text: 验证‘索引能提升查询性能’这个假设。
say.note: 触发完整的科学调查流程。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude follows a scientific method framework for engineering investigations: state a falsifiable hypothesis, design an experiment (variables, controls, sample size), collect raw data, perform statistical analysis, and output a provisional conclusion with limitations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need rigorous causal reasoning over vibes-based debugging, e.g., performance optimization, A/B comparison, or high-cost-of-being-wrong scenarios.

say_en.text: Compare the speed of two sorting algorithms with a rigorous experiment.
say_en.note: Claude will generate hypothesis, steps, and controls.

say_en.text: Verify the hypothesis that an index improves query performance.
